package.name: swarm_controller
package.description: This package contains a generic mobile robot control node, which steers robots with a differential drive. Currently only supports the Turtlebot3 and Foot-Bot. It contains a library of basic behaviors that can be customized via parameters. The node is directly connected to the runtime model of RuMROS, receiving commands on which behavior to activate. Via the behavior model of the runtime model, coordination between robots can be organized and behaviors can be adjusted accordingly. Usage: ros2 run swarm_controller node_main [group_id] [robot_id]
